mechanism: Both drugs are hepatically metabolized and may compete for CYP450 enzymes; albendazole can induce CYP3A4 potentially reducing minocycline levels, while both carry hepatotoxicity risk with combined use.
action: Monitor liver function tests at baseline and periodically during concurrent use; consider alternative antihelmintic if hepatic impairment present or if minocycline levels appear subtherapeutic.
